आज, Mon 23 Nov को दिल्ली में दिन हल्की धूप वाला और सुहाना, करीब 25 से 27°C, और रात ठंडी, करीब 10 से 12°C रहने का अंदाज़ा है। यह नवंबर के आख़िरी हफ़्ते के आम मौसम पर आधारित है, आज का ताज़ा हाल मैं अभी देख नहीं सकता।

सुबह-शाम धुंध और स्मॉग रह सकता है, बारिश की उम्मीद कम है। हवा अक्सर इन दिनों ख़राब रहती है, तो बाहर ज़्यादा देर रहना हो तो मास्क रख लो और शाम के लिए हल्की जैकेट।

Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
12:46 PM

Bagha was a young tiger in the hills of Ranthambore who had grown bored of raw meals and river water. One winter afternoon a picnic party left behind a dented steel pot, and inside it clung a few grains of golden rice that tasted like nothing he had ever known. From that day he could think of only one thing: making a whole pot of it himself.

He begged help from Meena, an old langur who had spent years stealing from temple kitchens and knew every spice by smell. She taught him to wash the rice three times, to brown the onions slowly instead of pouncing on them, and to count cardamom pods on his claws. His early pots were sad affairs, soggy at the top and black at the bottom, and once his own tail caught a spark and sent him leaping into the lake.

Then came the night he sealed the lid with dough, sat on his paws and simply waited, the hardest lesson of all for a tiger. When he lifted the lid, steam rose sweet with cloves and mint, and every grain stood apart. Deer, peacocks and even the grumpy sloth bear lined up with leaf plates, and from then on nobody in the forest feared Bagha's roar, because it only meant that dinner was ready.
